Results live in scattered notes, and remediation tracking is manual. item.title: guppylm
item.description:
## The Problem
Training a language model from scratch is usually framed as requiring deep expertise, large GPU clusters, and days of compute. GuppyLM demonstrates that a working transformer can be built, trained, and deployed in about five minutes on a single GPU. For engineers evaluating whether to invest in custom small models, it provides a concrete, minimal reference implementation of the full pipeline: data generation, tokenizer training, model definition, training loop, and inference.

item.description:

item.title: mgrep
item.description:
## The Problem
`grep` matches literal strings, not meaning. Searching a codebase for "where do we set up auth?" requires knowing the exact terms — `passport`, `session`, `middleware` — and even then you get a token match, not an answer. For multimodal content (PDFs, images), `grep` does not work at all. `mgrep` replaces that with semantic, natural-language search over your local files, indexed in the background.
